paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промяната в разредеността (sparsity ratio) на изхода на SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) по различните слоеве на модела, при прагова стойност 1e-2, като сравнява три конфигурации на врати (gating). Оста X, означена като „Layer“, представлява номера на слоя и варира от 0 до 22, с етикети на интервали от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y, означена като „Sparsity Ratio“, е линейна и покрива диапазона от 0.0 до 1.0, с етикети на интервали от 0.2. На графиката са представени три линии: синя пунктирана линия („sparsity ratio before gate“), оранжева точкована линия („sparsity ratio after gate“) и зелена шаркана линия („sparsity ratio after average gate“). Синята пунктирана линия започва при около 0.2 при слой 0, намалява рязко до около 0.05 при слой 5 и след това остава почти постоянна, близо до нула, до края на графика. Оранжевата точкована линия започва при 1.0 при слой 0, намалява бързо до около 0.3 при слой 5, след това продължава да намалява по-бавно и се стабилизира около 0.15 при слой 10, като след това остава почти постоянна, с леки колебания. Зелената шаркана линия започва при 1.0 при слой 0, намалява по-бавно от оранжевата линия, достига около 0.2 при слой 5, след това продължава да намалява по-бавно и се стабилизира около 0.15 при слой 10, като остава леко по-висока от оранжевата линия до края на графика. Трите линии не се пресичат след слой 5, като зелената линия винаги е по-висока от оранжевата, а синята линия е значително по-ниска от двете.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across network layers under a 1e-2 threshold, comparing three distinct gating configurations: “before gate,” “after gate,” and “after average gate.” The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear scaling and major tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The blue dashed line representing “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03” begins at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, drops sharply to near 0.05 by layer 3, and remains near zero through layer 23. The orange dotted line, “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44,” starts at 1.0 at layer 0, declines steeply to 0.5 by layer 5, continues decreasing to approximately 0.15 by layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly between 0.15 and 0.4 through layer 23. The green dash-dot line, “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33,” begins at 1.0, drops to 0.8 by layer 2, then declines more gradually to 0.15 by layer 10, and remains near that level with minor fluctuations through layer 23. Across all layers beyond layer 5, the green line consistently lies above the orange line, indicating higher sparsity in the after-average-gate configuration, and the two lines do not intersect after layer 5. The blue line remains consistently near zero throughout, indicating minimal sparsity in the pre-gating state.
model_annotations.English: The line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across 22 layers under a 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations: “before gate,” “after gate,” and “after average gate.” The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line (“sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”) begins at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, drops steeply to near 0.05 by layer 3, and remains nearly flat near zero through layer 22. The orange dotted line (“sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”) starts at 1.0 at layer 0, declines sharply to approximately 0.4 by layer 5, continues decreasing to about 0.15 by layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly between 0.15 and 0.2 through layer 22. The green dash-dot line (“sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”) also begins at 1.0 at layer 0, drops to about 0.6 by layer 5, then declines more gradually to approximately 0.1 by layer 15, and remains stable near 0.1 through layer 22. While the orange and green lines converge around layer 10, the green line remains consistently above the orange line for all subsequent layers, never intersecting again after layer 5. The blue line remains significantly lower than both throughout the entire range, indicating minimal sparsity in pre-gated states.
model_annotations.German: The line chart illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across network layers under a fixed threshold of 1e-2, comparing three gating configurations: “before gate,” “after gate,” and “after average gate.” The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22 with integer tick marks at intervals of 5, representing discrete model layers in a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, also on a linear scale. The blue dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03,” begins at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, drops sharply to near 0.05 by layer 3, and remains nearly flat and close to zero through layer 22. The orange dotted line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44,” starts at 1.0 at layer 0, declines steeply to 0.3 by layer 5, continues decreasing to approximately 0.15 by layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly between 0.15 and 0.4 through layer 22. The green dash-dot line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33,” begins at 1.0 at layer 0, drops to 0.6 by layer 5, then declines more gradually to approximately 0.1 by layer 15, and remains near that level through layer 22, consistently staying above the orange dotted line after layer 5 without intersecting it.
